Talen Energy Amazon power purchase agreement front-of-meter go-to-market change 2026

findings.claim: Talen與Amazon的Susquehanna供電由behind-the-meter改為front-of-the-meter，Talen擔任Amazon的零售電力供應商，PPL負責輸配電；合約最高1,920MW至2042年。
findings.source: World Nuclear News｜New supply agreement expands Talen-Amazon partnership

findings.claim: Q2 2026法說：CEO稱持續持有低成本基載發電並轉為長約，強調彈性結構而非策略方向改變；除AWS外尚無新長約簽訂。
findings.source: Nasdaq/Zacks｜TLN Q2 Earnings Call Emphasizes Cash Flow and Data Center Strategy
